contrastive_limit: Optional identity-projection ablation; source-level false negatives cannot all be excluded without batch source IDs.
convergence_claim: Stopping by patience or epoch budget does not prove a global optimum or sufficient training.

domain_augmentation.seed_policy: training seed + epoch * 1000003; epochs start at 1
domain_augmentation.source: original training db/cell_share every epoch; never cumulative
domain_augmentation.labels: share, presence and cell_share recomputed from augmented known components
domain_augmentation.interpretation: Smooth known-component domain randomization; not an exact propagation model.
